purpose: Freeze exact outcome-blind identity mirrors for ECRS and SCC/PBP before T2 sees trigger counts, excursions, trades, PnL, or any economic result.
prohibitions: No excursion, trade, PnL, win-rate, PF, expectancy, drawdown, or chart-outcome field may be read or emitted.
D7 and D8 cannot select, tune, rescue, promote, rank, or contribute trial credit to A0-A4.
No threshold or event key may be changed after any real-data identity count is exposed; a necessary pre-outcome change requires a new V2 contract.
ECRS v2 is secondary diagnostic only and cannot replace the exact ECRS v1 mirror required by P0/P2.
Formula-generalization results on symbols other than EURUSD are not prior-identity overlap claims.

gates.barrier: prior rolling 12-completed-bar high for long or low for short
gates.breakout: completed close breaks the directional 12-bar barrier
gates.bias: EMA20 side and 3-bar slope in breakout direction
gates.entry_projection: next M5 bar only; next-bar existence/time/open/spread may be used, never its future path

d7_ecrs_exact_mirror.comparison_population: All T2 structural candidate identities A0-A3 before probability thresholding and daily consumption, using completed-bar signal time and next-open entry time.
d7_ecrs_exact_mirror.jaccard: size(intersection) / size(union); empty/empty is INVALID, never zero or pass.
d7_ecrs_exact_mirror.fatal_gate: Close T2 before build when Jaccard > 0.50 and the residual decisions cannot be attributed to immutable locked-barrier provenance plus causal event order/duration from P2.
secondary_diagnostics: Per-arm A0-A3 Jaccard against ECRS v1.
ECRS v2 no-volume identity count and Jaccard, clearly labeled non-primary.
Formula-generalization on the other eight symbols, clearly labeled not prior-identity overlap.

t2_pbp_like_population.eligibility: An otherwise structurally valid A3 candidate before the hard PBP exclusion fires.

subsets.PBP_BREAK_WINDOW: A same-direction immutable locked-barrier close-break occurred in k-7..t-1.
subsets.PBP_TOMBSTONE_CONTACT: The correction contacted a tombstone of a previously broken same-direction barrier.

t2_pbp_like_population.economic_authority: NONE; every event remains SKIP_PBP_EXCLUDED and absent from A4.

scc_control_identity.sequence: confirmed N=2 fractal pivot -> first completed close break; pivot consumed on the first break

scc_challenger_identity.sequence: SCC control break -> next retained M5 bar HOLD -> first-passage retest within 12 bars

d8_pbp_scc_mirror.price_match: Exact symbol-tick price equality after both references are normalized to the same symbol tick size.
comparison_outputs: T2 PBP_BREAK_WINDOW vs SCC_CONTROL_BREAK exact intersection and Jaccard
T2 PBP_TOMBSTONE_CONTACT vs SCC_CHALLENGER_RETEST exact intersection and Jaccard
Unmatched identities with causal reason codes only
d8_pbp_scc_mirror.decision_rule: D8 is diagnostic-only. Any material semantic reconstruction of SCC forces a pre-build T2 close or a fresh generation; D8 cannot authorize a PBP arm.

implementation_acceptance: Pure deterministic emitters and comparator; no outcome columns accepted by the API.
SHA verification of every bound source before execution.
Exact-key, empty-set invalidity, duplicate-key rejection, timezone, symbol-tick normalization and long-short mirror fixtures.
Prefix invariance for both mirrors and T2 identity emitters.
Full identity ledgers are used; sampled casebooks are forbidden for Jaccard.
Execution remains blocked until the design-only price input is covered by the frozen T2 data epoch and all data-quality constraints.
